heading: One destination, two journeys
description: Discover the magic of our Victorian castle resort whichever way you choose. Join us on the mountain for a day of relaxation and adventure, or stay overnight to fully immerse yourself in everything Mohonk has to offer. Whatever your choice, our Hudson Valley resort provides a warm, welcoming escape, full of opportunities to connect — with loved ones, with nature, and with yourself.
